description: the lateral force is a periodic lateral mode, not a slow one-way drift; its peak amplitude is larger at the end of the run than at the start and has not saturated by the end of the run
note: not used by the registered gate; the paper reports the half-window ratio and complete-cycle amplitudes
method: peaks are local maxima of |Fz| above 1e-4; exponential_growth_rate_per_time and e_folding_time are a two-point log-slope fit between the first and last peak, kept as computed and not a claim that the growth is exponential
